RECOMMENDATION: IT DEPENDS
LIKELIHOOD: 55

An all-male panel is not definitive proof of discrimination, but it heightens the risk of affinity bias and in-group favoritism, especially given your stronger formal credentials. However, senior municipal appointments also hinge on interview dynamics, political fit, and specific leadership experience like public consultation. 

Do not level accusations of sex discrimination immediately, as this will trigger defensiveness and close doors. First, send a professional follow-up regarding your feedback. Because this is a public municipality, interview rubrics, scoring matrices, and hiring criteria are often subject to public records requests (such as FOIA). If documented irregularities or unexplained scoring gaps emerge, consult an employment attorney or equity officer before deciding to raise a formal grievance.
